# Hustle & Heir — asset production checklist

The complete asset checklist for **Hustle & Heir**, expanded from the original asset brief into
tracked, prioritised, ID'd line items.

Every deliverable is a checkbox with a stable ID, a provenance tag (`[S]` from the brief,
`[D]` derived to make an `[S]` item shippable) and a priority (`[P0]` vertical slice, `[P1]`
alpha, `[P2]` launch). Counts and progress are generated, not hand-maintained.

## Canonical code lists

**Districts (12):** `DTC` Downtown Core · `UNI` University · `OLD` Old Town · `IND` Industrial ·
`ENT` Entertainment · `WTR` Waterfront · `SUB` Suburbs · `MYH` Mystic Heights · `ARC` Arcane
District · `UND` Underground · `RUR` Rural · `GOV` Government Center

**Careers (10):** `CUL` Cultivator · `SCH` Arcane Scholar · `HAC` Cyber Hacker · `UDW` Underworld ·
`INF` Influencer · `HEI` Corporate Heir · `MEC` Mechanic / Artisan · `MIL` Military / PMC ·
`POL` Politician · `CLT` Cultist / Secret Society

**Melee classes (6):** `FST` fists/gauntlets · `DAG` daggers · `SWD` swords · `GSW` greatswords ·
`BLT` blunt · `POL` polearms

**Ranged classes (6):** `PST` pistol · `SMG` submachine gun · `SHG` shotgun · `RIF` assault rifle ·
`DMR` marksman rifle · `SNP` sniper

> `POL` is used for both the polearm weapon class and the Politician career. They never collide in
> an ID because the prefixes differ (`WPN-MEL-POL-*` vs `CR-POL-*`), but avoid bare `POL` in
> folder or file names — use `Polearm` and `Politician`.

## Working the checklist

```bash
# validate IDs + assert the brief's numbers + print the roll-up
python3 tools/check_checklist.py

# ...and refresh the progress table in this file
python3 tools/check_checklist.py --write

# export everything for a tracker or spreadsheet
python3 tools/check_checklist.py --csv build/checklist.csv
```

`--write` and `--check` keep the table above honest: if you tick items and forget to regenerate,
`--check` fails. The script also fails on duplicate IDs, unregistered prefixes and any breach of
the brief's numeric requirements (5 body frames, 30+ sliders, 40+ hairstyles, 20+ irises,
15+ tattoos, 12 districts, 10 vehicles, 6+6 weapon classes, 6 spell shapes, 10 auras, 10 careers).
